action.command:
cd /var/openhands/conversations && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, glob, os
for d in sorted(glob.glob('*')):
    m = os.path.join(d,'meta.json')
    if not os.path.exists(m): continue
    try:
        j = json.load(open(m))
    except Exception as e:
        print(d, 'ERR', e); continue
    title = j.get('title') or j.get('name')
    print(d, '|', title, '|', j.get('created_at'), '|', j.get('last_updated') or j.get('updated_at'))
EOF
